scope: Issue #121 named source; bounded single-source extraction, not a literature search

use_case_changes.note: Links are added to the use_case records by the integrator after review (records -- change). Proposed evidence-gap text is in report.md of the ML-versus-baseline pass, not in the store.

gaps: Per-tool sensitivity, precision and F1 for all isolates, species in and out of the database and the three genus-size strata are shown only in Figure 3 (values drawn on the figure); only the four values printed in the text are extracted.
Community-level sensitivity, precision and F1 at 0.001, 0.1 and 1% thresholds are only in Figure 4b; not read.
Figure 2 (MetageNN, GeNet and DeepMicrobes on the 47-genome small database; epoch time, speed, F1) compares machine-learning methods only and was not extracted, including its prose values.
Relative improvements printed in the text (sensitivity gains of 100%, 23%, 17% and 36%; memory reductions of 77%, 61%, 83% and 96%) were not recorded.
The authors' repository (csb5/MetageNN at d7c858cee1b88bf78fb1ea7d120b3be180a52b69) holds code and genome or SRA lists, no result tables.
concerns_for_reviewer: Table 1 prints Kraken2 speed as 13.471 reads/sec; the Results text says 13,471 and calls Kraken2 the fastest. The cell is recorded with numeric_value null and source_discrepancy, and the text value as a separate result. Decide whether a source evidence_concern is warranted.
Database storage memory uses a new metric concept, reference-storage-size (data/vocab/metric.ttl). Review it like a record change.
The resources protocol links to the isolate dataset although the article does not say which reads were timed.

The isolates protocol carries baseline values (all isolates) and one MetageNN stratum (out-of-database, more than three species per genus) with no shared subset; check that this is acceptable as one protocol.
MEGAN-LR here runs on minimap2 nucleotide alignments; minimap2 is not scored on its own.
review_corrections: dna-pathogen-20261012-metagenn-method-metamaps removed at review: it duplicated dna-pathogen-20261009-method-metamaps, which config-metamaps now configures.
dna-pathogen-20261012-metagenn-eval-metagenn-isolates excluded from the isolates judgement: its printed values cover a subset with no printed baseline value.
